v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Rex pacíficus * magnificátus est, cuius vultum desíderat univérsa terra.
text.en: The King of Peace * is magnified, whose face the whole earth desireth.

text.la: Magnificátus est * Rex pacíficus super omnes reges univérsæ terræ.
text.en: The Peaceful King * exceeded all the kings of the whole earth.

text.la: Compléti sunt * dies Maríæ, ut páreret Fílium suum primogénitum.
text.en: The days of Mary * were accomplished that she should bring forth her first-born Son.

text.la: Scitóte * quia prope est regnum Dei: amen dico vobis, quia non tardábit.
text.en: Know ye that the kingdom * of God is at hand? Amen, I say unto you, it will not tarry.

text.la: Leváte cápita vestra: * ecce appropínquat redémptio vestra.
text.en: Lift up your heads; * behold, your redemption draweth nigh.

text.la: Appáruit benígnitas, et humánitas Salvatóris nostri Dei: non ex opéribus iustítiæ, quæ fécimus nos, sed secúndum suam misericórdiam salvos nos fecit.
text.en: But when the goodness and kindness of God our Saviour appeared: Not by the works of justice, which we have done, but according to his mercy, he saved us.

v.en: Tomorrow the iniquity of the earth shall be blotted out.

r.la: Et regnábit super nos Salvátor mundi.
r.en: And the Saviour of the world shall reign over us.

text.la: Cum ortus fúerit * sol de cælo, vidébitis Regem regum procedéntem a Patre, tamquam sponsum de thálamo suo.
text.en: When the sun shall have risen * from heaven, ye shall see the King of kings proceeding from the Father, as a bridegroom from his chamber.

text.la: Concéde, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut nos Unigéniti tui nova per carnem Natívitas líberet; quos sub peccáti iugo vetústa sérvitus tenet.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, almighty God, that the new birth of thy Only-begotten Son as man may set us free, who are held by the old bondage under the yoke of sin.
